### 🖥️ Secure Antigravity Desktop / Local Handoff Instructions
*n8n Cloud cannot connect directly to localhost. Follow these steps to reproduce and triage locally:*

1. **Checkout the exact failing commit:**
   ```bash
   git fetch origin
   git checkout {{ $('Verify Conclusion & SHA').item.json.head_sha }}
   ```
2. **Inspect Artifacts & Traces:**
   Download the Playwright trace archive from GitHub Actions Run #{{ $('Verify Conclusion & SHA').item.json.run_number }}.
3. **Local Fix & Push:**
   Fix the issue and commit to trigger the next validation run.",
  "labels": ["qa-failure", "automated-triage"]
